label: The six end-to-end demonstrations the project requirements call for. One fictional company, Fixture Co; every record is synthetic. Each entry names what its run must show.

moving_at_build.note: On 2026-11-26 the integration brief said the hosting, agency and corporate fleets might still be finishing, and the foundation tightened its evidence gate and scanner during the build. A demo that loads one of these fleets is marked depends_on_moving_fleet.

demos.title: Accessible multilingual agency deliverable with a hosting and support handoff
demos.human_boundary: Linguistic review of the Spanish and Arabic pages stays with human:language-reviewer; no donor or editor research has run.

demos.title: Hosting restoration exercise with evidence and a follow-up improvement
demos.human_boundary: The external message stays a draft for human:communications-approver; the follow-up IMP-002 waits for a patch and pinned cases from the hosting fleet.

demos.title: Small extension and API release with tested docs, a developer workshop and staged marketing
demos.human_boundary: Release approval stays with human:release-owner; the launch copy's source register waits for a human sign-off and the copy for human:marketing-approver; human onboarding usability is unmeasured.

demos.title: Community onboarding and governance scenario with a feedback-to-product handoff
demos.human_boundary: Measured follow-up needs real community activity after the change; the moderation case is decided by human:trust-safety-lead.

demos.title: BCIT unit with authentic business and computing tasks, an honest standards mapping, complete materials and an assessment
demos.human_boundary: Learner work and results come only from the teacher of record; the objectives step used the labeled fake tool because no objective-writing script exists.

demos.title: Trainer-development package with a facilitation guide, a rubric calibration exercise and a plan to collect actual learning evidence
demos.human_boundary: Inter-rater agreement needs real ratings from human raters; learning and transfer evidence needs real sessions.
